description: Find upcoming exams, midterms, finals and tests across your courses: the date, points, about how much of your grade each one is, and why it was picked (its name, its assignment group or a course calendar event). Read-only. It is a best guess, so tell the student to check the syllabus. Use it for "when are my exams?"

course_id.description: Only this course (from list_courses). Leave it out to check your active courses.

days.description: How many days ahead to look, 1 to 180. Default 60.

title: Find Exams
